description: Search the TwitchBoard catalog of free browser tools for streamers (Twitch, OBS, YouTube, Discord, TikTok, Kick, stream graphics, name generators). Use it when the user needs to do something hands-on that needs a UI, such as resizing an emote, designing a panel, making a banner or setting up an overlay, and you want to send them to a free tool that does it. Returns matching tools with a one-line description and URL. Leave "query" empty to list a whole category.

limit.description: Maximum number of tools to return.

query.description: What the user wants to do, e.g. "resize emote", "starting soon screen", "chat overlay".

name: search_tools
title: Find a streamer tool
